query.commandtext: SELECT * FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime
SELECT DISTINCT WAFER_ID FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOT_ID IN (??) ORDER BY WAFER_ID
SELECT DISTINCT ?? FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime AND TRIM(??) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'GOOD' AS SECTION, FACTORY, LOT_ID, LOT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TRAN_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS'), 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, FLOW, FLOW_DESC, FLOW_NO, OPER, OPER_DESC, OPER_LONG_DESC, FLOW_OPER_SEQ, FLOW_AREA, RES_ID, RES_MODEL, RES_AREA FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOT_ID IN (??) ?? UNION SELECT 'BAD' AS SECTION, FACTORY, LOT_ID, LOT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TRAN_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS'), 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, FLOW, FLOW_DESC, FLOW_NO, OPER, OPER_DESC, OPER_LONG_DESC, FLOW_OPER_SEQ, FLOW_AREA, RES_ID, RES_MODEL, RES_AREA FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOT_ID IN (??) ??

SELECT ?? , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT 'GOOD' AS SECTION, FACTORY, LOT_ID, LOT_TYPE, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, FLOW, FLOW_DESC, FLOW_NO, OPER, OPER_DESC, OPER_LONG_DESC, FLOW_OPER_SEQ, FLOW_AREA, RES_ID, RES_MODEL, RES_AREA FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOT_ID IN (??) ?? UNION SELECT 'BAD' AS SECTION, FACTORY, LOT_ID, LOT_TYPE, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, FLOW, FLOW_DESC, FLOW_NO, OPER, OPER_DESC, OPER_LONG_DESC, FLOW_OPER_SEQ, FLOW_AREA, RES_ID, RES_MODEL, RES_AREA FROM TQC_LOT_HIS WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOT_ID IN (??) ??)
WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ?? ORDER BY ??

SELECT 'GOOD' AS SECTION, TO_CHAR (a.tran_time, 'yy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS tran_time, a.start_time, a.lot_id, a.slot_no, a.wafer_id, a.lpt, a.opn, a.recipe, a.description, a.equip, a.para_1, a.para_2, a.para_3, a.para_4, a.para_5, a.para_6, a.para_7, a.para_8, a.para_9, a.para_10, a.para_11, a.para_12, a.para_13, a.para_14, a.para_15, a.lpt_no FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER A WHERE 1 = 1 and lot_id in (??) and wafer_id in (??) ?? UNION SELECT 'BAD' AS SECTION, TO_CHAR (a.tran_time, 'yy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS tran_time, a.start_time, a.lot_id, a.slot_no, a.wafer_id, a.lpt, a.opn, a.recipe, a.description, a.equip, a.para_1, a.para_2, a.para_3, a.para_4, a.para_5, a.para_6, a.para_7, a.para_8, a.para_9, a.para_10, a.para_11, a.para_12, a.para_13, a.para_14, a.para_15, a.lpt_no FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER A WHERE 1 = 1 and lot_id in (??) and wafer_id in (??) ??

SELECT ?? , COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT * FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 and lot_id in (??) and wafer_id in (??) ?? UNION SELECT * FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER WHERE 1 = 1 and lot_id in (??) and wafer_id in (??) ??) WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ?? ORDER BY ??
SELECT DISTINCT ?? FROM TQC_TREND_VIEW WHERE 1 = 1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') ?? GROUP BY ?? ORDER BY ??
SELECT DISTINCT STEP_ID FROM TQC_TREND_VIEW WHERE 1 = 1 AND TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') ?? GROUP BY STEP_ID ORDER BY STEP_ID

-- CREATE TIME: 2019-12-10 19:26:00 SELECT EQUIP, ?? , SUM(DEFECTS) AS DEFECTS, SUM(REVIEW_SUM) AS REVIEW_SUM FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTS, DECODE (GROUPING_ID (CLASSNUMBER), 0, CLASSNUMBER, -1) AS CLASSNUMBER, SUM (CNT) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT T2.PRODUCT, T2.LOT_ID, T2.WAFER_ID, T2.STEP_ID, T2.SLOT_ID, T1.LPT, T1.OPN, T1.TRAN_TIME, T1.RECIPE, T1.DESCRIPTION, T1.EQUIP, T1.PARA_1, T1.PARA_2, T1.PARA_3, T1.PARA_4, T1.PARA_5, T1.PARA_6, T1.PARA_7, T1.PARA_8, T1.PARA_9, T1.PARA_10, T1.PARA_11, T1.PARA_12, T1.PARA_13, T1.PARA_14, T1.PARA_15, T2.STEP_SEQ, T2.DEFECTS, T3.CLASSNUMBER, T3.CLUSTERNUMBER, DECODE (T3.CLUSTERNUMBER, 0, COUNT (*), 1) AS CNT FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER T1, TQD_INSP_INFO T2, TQD_DEFECT T3 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_ID = T2.LOT_ID AND T1.WAFER_ID = T2.WAFER_ID AND T2.STEP_SEQ = T3.STEP_SEQ AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T3.WAFER_SEQ AND T1.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND T1.EQUIP = :equipment ?? AND T3.CLASSNUMBER NOT IN (0) -- UNCATEGORIZED 제외 GROUP BY T2.PRODUCT, T2.LOT_ID, T2.WAFER_ID, T2.STEP_ID, T2.SLOT_ID, T1.LPT, T1.OPN, T1.TRAN_TIME, T1.RECIPE, T1.DESCRIPTION, T1.EQUIP, T1.PARA_1, T1.PARA_2, T1.PARA_3, T1.PARA_4, T1.PARA_5, T1.PARA_6, T1.PARA_7, T1.PARA_8, T1.PARA_9, T1.PARA_10, T1.PARA_11, T1.PARA_12, T1.PARA_13, T1.PARA_14, T1.PARA_15, T2.STEP_SEQ, T2.DEFECTS, T3.CLASSNUMBER, T3.CLUSTERNUMBER) GROUP BY PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTS, ROLLUP (CLASSNUMBER)) PIVOT (SUM (CNT) FOR (CLASSNUMBER) IN (-1 AS REVIEW_SUM, ??)) GROUP BY EQUIP, ?? ORDER BY EQUIP, ??

-- CREATE TIME: 2019-12-10 19:26:00 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTS, DECODE (GROUPING_ID (CLASSNUMBER), 0, CLASSNUMBER, -1) AS CLASSNUMBER, SUM (CNT) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT T2.PRODUCT, T2.LOT_ID, T2.WAFER_ID, T2.STEP_ID, T2.SLOT_ID, T1.LPT, T1.OPN, T1.TRAN_TIME, T1.RECIPE, T1.DESCRIPTION, T1.EQUIP, T1.PARA_1, T1.PARA_2, T1.PARA_3, T1.PARA_4, T1.PARA_5, T1.PARA_6, T1.PARA_7, T1.PARA_8, T1.PARA_9, T1.PARA_10, T1.PARA_11, T1.PARA_12, T1.PARA_13, T1.PARA_14, T1.PARA_15, T2.STEP_SEQ, T2.DEFECTS, T3.CLASSNUMBER, T3.CLUSTERNUMBER, DECODE (T3.CLUSTERNUMBER, 0, COUNT (*), 1) AS CNT FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER T1, TQD_INSP_INFO T2, TQD_DEFECT T3 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_ID = T2.LOT_ID AND T1.WAFER_ID = T2.WAFER_ID AND T2.STEP_SEQ = T3.STEP_SEQ AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T3.WAFER_SEQ AND T1.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND T1.EQUIP = :equipment ?? AND T3.CLASSNUMBER NOT IN (0) -- UNCATEGORIZED 제외 GROUP BY T2.PRODUCT, T2.LOT_ID, T2.WAFER_ID, T2.STEP_ID, T2.SLOT_ID, T1.LPT, T1.OPN, T1.TRAN_TIME, T1.RECIPE, T1.DESCRIPTION, T1.EQUIP, T1.PARA_1, T1.PARA_2, T1.PARA_3, T1.PARA_4, T1.PARA_5, T1.PARA_6, T1.PARA_7, T1.PARA_8, T1.PARA_9, T1.PARA_10, T1.PARA_11, T1.PARA_12, T1.PARA_13, T1.PARA_14, T1.PARA_15, T2.STEP_SEQ, T2.DEFECTS, T3.CLASSNUMBER, T3.CLUSTERNUMBER) GROUP BY PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTS, ROLLUP (CLASSNUMBER)) PIVOT (SUM (CNT) FOR (CLASSNUMBER) IN (-1 AS REVIEW_SUM, ??)) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

SELECT EQUIP, ?? FROM (SELECT t2.PRODUCT, t2.LOT_ID, t2.WAFER_ID, t2.STEP_ID, t2.SLOT_ID, t1.LPT, t1.OPN, t1.TRAN_TIME, t1.RECIPE, t1.DESCRIPTION, t1.EQUIP, t1.PARA_1, t1.PARA_2, t1.PARA_3, t1.PARA_4, t1.PARA_5, t1.PARA_6, t1.PARA_7, t1.PARA_8, t1.PARA_9, t1.PARA_10, t1.PARA_11, t1.PARA_12, t1.PARA_13, t1.PARA_14, t1.PARA_15, t3.* FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER t1, tqd_insp_info t2, tqd_insp_sum t3 WHERE 1=1 and t1.lot_id = t2.lot_id and t1.wafer_id = t2.wafer_id and t2.step_seq = t3.step_seq AND T1.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND T1.EQUIP = :equipment ?? ) GROUP BY EQUIP, ?? SELECT * FROM (SELECT t2.PRODUCT, t2.LOT_ID, t2.WAFER_ID, t2.STEP_ID, t2.SLOT_ID, t1.LPT, t1.OPN, t1.TRAN_TIME, t1.RECIPE, t1.DESCRIPTION, t1.EQUIP, t1.PARA_1, t1.PARA_2, t1.PARA_3, t1.PARA_4, t1.PARA_5, t1.PARA_6, t1.PARA_7, t1.PARA_8, t1.PARA_9, t1.PARA_10, t1.PARA_11, t1.PARA_12, t1.PARA_13, t1.PARA_14, t1.PARA_15, t3.* FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER t1, tqd_insp_info t2, tqd_insp_sum t3 WHERE 1=1 and t1.lot_id = t2.lot_id and t1.wafer_id = t2.wafer_id and t2.step_seq = t3.step_seq AND T1.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND T1.EQUIP = :equipment ?? ) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

-- CREATE TIME: 2019-12-10 19:26:00 SELECT EQUIP, ?? , SUM(DEFECTIVE_DIE) AS DEFECTIVE_DIE, SUM(REVIEW_SUM) AS REVIEW_SUM FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTIVE_DIE, DECODE (GROUPING_ID (CLASSNUMBER), 0, CLASSNUMBER, -1) AS CLASSNUMBER, SUM (CNT) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT, LOT_ID, WAFER_ID, STEP_ID, SLOT_ID, LPT, OPN, TRAN_TIME, RECIPE, DESCRIPTION, EQUIP, PARA_1, PARA_2, PARA_3, PARA_4, PARA_5, PARA_6, PARA_7, PARA_8, PARA_9, PARA_10, PARA_11, PARA_12, PARA_13, PARA_14, PARA_15, STEP_SEQ, DEFECTIVE_DIE, CLASSNUMBER, CLUSTERNUMBER, DECODE (CLUSTERNUMBER, 0, COUNT (*), 1) AS CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T2.PRODUCT, T2.LOT_ID, T2.WAFER_ID, T2.STEP_ID, T2.SLOT_ID, T1.LPT, T1.OPN, T1.TRAN_TIME, T1.RECIPE, T1.DESCRIPTION, T1.EQUIP, T1.PARA_1, T1.PARA_2, T1.PARA_3, T1.PARA_4, T1.PARA_5, T1.PARA_6, T1.PARA_7, T1.PARA_8, T1.PARA_9, T1.PARA_10, T1.PARA_11, T1.PARA_12, T1.PARA_13, T1.PARA_14, T1.PARA_15, T2.DEFECTIVE_DIE, T2.STEP_SEQ, T3.XINDEX * 65536 + T3.YINDEX, T3.CLASSNUMBER, T3.CLUSTERNUMBER FROM TQC_LOT_HIS_WAFER T1, TQD_INSP_INFO T2, TQD_DEFECT T3 WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.LOT_ID = T2.LOT_ID AND T1.WAFER_ID = T2.WAFER_ID AND T2.STEP_SEQ = T3.STEP_SEQ AND T2.WAFER_SEQ = T3.WAFER_SEQ AND T1.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sttime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND TO_DATE (:endtime, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') AND T1.EQUIP = :equipment ??
